narrative.overview: RepoLens is a darkroom where a repository is developed into evidence. The interface is a contact sheet: black ground, white frame borders, silver edge codes, and a single grease-pencil red that marks what can be pressed or what is currently selected. Every technology is a numbered frame; the agent's run is a strip of exposures; the report is the proof sheet you read after the roll is developed.
keyCharacteristics: Flat darkroom black and photo-paper white with silver metadata.
One grease red reserved for actions and active selection.
Contact-sheet frames, edge codes, and numbered technology cards.
Self-hosted compact geometric grotesque; typewriter for data.
No glass, glow, gradient text, or rounded dashboard cards.

rules.name: The Grease Pencil Rule
rules.body: Red is a mark, not a mood. Use it for the action, the active state, and the selected frame; never for a headline, an inactive icon, or a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Frame Rule
rules.body: Every panel is a rectangle with a 1px rule. No rounded card, no glass, no floating shadow.

rules.name: The Edge-Code Rule
rules.body: Mono is reserved for data that behaves like a frame number, coordinate, version, or count. Do not set body copy in mono to signal technical.

dos: Do use red only for action, selection, and active state.
Do keep every frame square and bordered at 1px.
Do number frames and use mono for counts, versions, and edge codes.
Do keep the proof strip horizontal at desktop and stack it at mobile.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, glass, glow, gradient text, or a colored left stripe.
Don't use red for headings or inactive icons.
Don't turn the contact sheet into a simulated camera or terminal.
Don't add a second display face or a system display face.
Don't replace the report table with a grid of equal cards.
